## Who may do what

For each action, the combinations `sekisho check` walked, put together where Cedar answers them alike and the same policies decide. Rows that differ in one column only are one row, the column holding their values: `any` is every value the column takes, `not …` every value but one. `-` is a column that does not apply to the row (the roles of a workflow, say).

- Principals: `User`, `Bot`. Resources: `Doc`, `Folder`.

## Policies

Each policy as the `.gate` writes it, beside the Cedar `sekisho gen --target cedar` generates for it. A permit allows the combinations it applies to; a forbid denies those it applies to, and wins where a permit applies too. Cedar denies a combination no policy applies to.

### permit `readers_read`

An editor or a viewer reads what is not archived, within the tenant

- On `read`, it allows 216 combinations, and no other permit allows any of them.

`tests/gen/conditions.gate`

```gate
permit readers_read
  description "An editor or a viewer reads what is not archived, within the tenant"
  principal in editor, viewer
  action read
  when resource.tenant is principal.tenant
  unless resource.archived
```

`cedar/conditions.cedar`

```cedar
@id("conditions/readers_read")
@doc("An editor or a viewer reads what is not archived, within the tenant")
permit (
  principal,
  action == Lab::Action::"read",
  resource
)
when { principal in Lab::Role::"editor" || principal in Lab::Role::"viewer" }
when { resource.tenant == principal.tenant }
unless { resource has archived && resource.archived };
```

### permit `bots_read_their_department`

A bot reads a document of its department, when it has 20 pages or fewer, or is urgent

- On `read`, it allows 18 combinations, and no other permit allows any of them.

`tests/gen/conditions.gate`

```gate
permit bots_read_their_department
  description "A bot reads a document of its department, when it has 20 pages or fewer, or is urgent"
  principal is Bot
  action read
  when principal.dept is resource.dept
  when pages <= 20 or urgent
```

`cedar/conditions.cedar`

```cedar
@id("conditions/bots_read_their_department")
@doc("A bot reads a document of its department, when it has 20 pages or fewer, or is urgent")
permit (
  principal is Lab::Bot,
  action == Lab::Action::"read",
  resource
)
when { resource has dept && principal.dept == resource.dept }
when { context.pages <= 20 || context.urgent };
```

### permit `editors_edit`

An editor in the document's team, or who reviews it, edits it when it is not high or the editor's clearance is 3 or more

- On `edit`, it allows 24 combinations, and no other permit allows any of them.

`tests/gen/conditions.gate`

```gate
permit editors_edit
  description "An editor in the document's team, or who reviews it, edits it when it is not high or the editor's clearance is 3 or more"
  principal in editor
  action edit
  when principal in resource.team or resource.reviewer is principal
  when resource.level is not high or principal.clearance >= 3
```

`cedar/conditions.cedar`

```cedar
@id("conditions/editors_edit")
@doc("An editor in the document's team, or who reviews it, edits it when it is not high or the editor's clearance is 3 or more")
permit (
  principal in Lab::Role::"editor",
  action == Lab::Action::"edit",
  resource is Lab::Doc
)
when
{
  principal in resource.team ||
  resource has reviewer &&
  resource.reviewer == principal
}
when { !(resource.level == "high") || principal.clearance >= 3 };
```

### forbid `nobody_on_leave`

Whoever is on leave does nothing

- On `read`, it applies to 416 combinations and denies them; a permit applies to 108 of them too.
- On `edit`, it applies to 48 combinations and denies them; a permit applies to 12 of them too.

`tests/gen/conditions.gate`

```gate
forbid nobody_on_leave
  description "Whoever is on leave does nothing"
  action any
  when principal.on_leave is true
```

`cedar/conditions.cedar`

```cedar
@id("conditions/nobody_on_leave")
@doc("Whoever is on leave does nothing")
forbid (
  principal,
  action in [Lab::Action::"read", Lab::Action::"edit"],
  resource
)
when { principal has on_leave && principal.on_leave == true };
```

## Roles

- `editor`: Edits documents.
- `viewer`: Reads documents.

Whether a principal holding one role alone (and the roles it includes) is allowed each action: always, in every combination of the rest; sometimes, allowed in some combinations and denied in others; never, denied in every one. `-` is an action that does not take the principal's type. Where a role writes `can`, `sekisho check` holds the actions it is always or sometimes allowed to it.

| principal | `read` | `edit` |
|---|---|---|
| `User` holding `editor` | sometimes | sometimes |
| `User` holding `viewer` | sometimes | never |
| `Bot` | sometimes | - |

## Operations guarded

No action guards an operation of a contract.
